delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm god-function gates for run_ticket2dsl in src/koru/autonomy/ticket2dsl.py (fan-out 20->8, mutations 26->4, CC 10->5) by returning early skip/error outcomes straight from the Ticket2dslOutcome constructor, extracting the KORU_TICKET2DSL_MAX_UNITS/argument cap into _resolve_unit_limit, the post-build outcome snapshot into _ran_outcome, the koru.ticket-work-unit-set/v1 payload into _unit_set_payload and the three artifact writes into _write_ticket2dsl_artifacts/_write_artifact, and by having build_work_units return the private _BuiltUnits NamedTuple so the orchestrator reads .units/.filtered instead of unpacking a bare tuple, while preserving identical skip reasons, check order, limit resolution with max(1, ...) clamping, partial outcome-field population on every early return, OSError capture into outcome.error, artifact file names and payload contents.
nonGoals: Refactoring the other god-flagged functions in this module (separate planfile tickets)
Changing sprint loading, open-status handling, usefulness filtering or unit scoring/ranking
Altering the work-unit contract, planfile DSL or intent JSONL rendering
Extracting code into a new module (patch targets must stay module-local)

architecture.decision: Keep the pipeline in one module: run_ticket2dsl stays a linear guard/build/snapshot/write sequence that constructs skip and error outcomes directly instead of mutating one shared object, and the artifact writing is split into a payload renderer plus a per-file writer so each helper owns a bounded slice of the outcome writes. build_work_units returns a private NamedTuple so callers read fields and the tuple-unpack mutation double-count stays out of the orchestrator.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline run_ticket2dsl body with a bare (units, filtered) tuple return.

validation.evidence: run_ticket2dsl and every touched or new helper re-measure below the code2llm god-function gates (fan-out 20->8, mutations 26->4, CC 10->5; all <= fan-out 10 / mutations 6 / CC 12).
All existing ticket2dsl tests pass unchanged.
